description: Roll a room's authoritative logic back to a prior version by re-deploying it as a new version (history stays intact). Omit toVersion to restore the previous version.

game.description: Which game to act on: its publishable key (pk_…) or its exact name. Defaults to the x-mp-game header, then your primary game.

toVersion.description: Version to restore (default: the previous version).

name: rollback_room_logic
title: Roll back authoritative logic
